message.content:
The “best” month really depends on what you’re after—weather, crowd levels, or cost—but most travelers find the shoulder seasons (late spring and early fall) offer the sweet spot:

| Season | Typical Weather | Crowd Level | Price Trend |
|--------|-----------------|-------------|--------------|
| **Late Spring (April–May)** | Warm, sunny days (average highs ~80 °F/27 °C), cooler evenings (~65 °F/18 °C). | Moderate – less crowded than summer peak. | Prices start to rise toward late May as schools finish up. |
| **Summer (June–August)** | Hotest period (highs 85–90 °F/29–32 °C), humidity rises. | Peak season – busiest beaches, higher hotel rates. | Highest airfare & accommodation costs. |
| **Early Fall (September–October)** | Still warm (mid‑70s to low‑80s °F / 24–28 °C), humidity drops. | Lower crowds after school vacations end. | Rates dip back down into mid‑fall. |

**Bottom line:**  
If you want pleasant temperatures with fewer crowds and better deals, aim for **late April through early May or September through early October**. Those months usually have average daily highs around 80 °F (27 °C) and nights comfortably cool enough for beach walks at sunset.  

(If you’d like the exact average temperatures for a particular month, let me know and I can pull them for you.)
